تبوك وحديث المنزلة: Tabuk and the hadith of the station
«ثم كانت غزاة تبوك، فأوحى الله تبارك وتع: “Then came the expedition of Tabuk. God, blessed and exalted be His name, revealed to His Prophet (God bless him and his family) that he should go to it himself and call the people out to go with him. He told him that he would need no war in it and would not be put to fighting an enemy, that matters would yield to him without a sword, and He bound him to test his companions by going out with him and to try them, so that they would be set apart by it and what they hid would show.”
«فاستنفرهم النبي صلى الله عليه وآله إلى: “The Prophet (God bless him and his family) called them out to the lands of Rome when their fruit had ripened and the heat had grown fierce upon them. Most of them were slow to obey him, out of desire for what was at hand, care for their livelihood and its upkeep, and fear of the fierce heat, the length of the road and meeting the enemy. Then some of them rose, reluctant to rise, and others stayed behind.”
«وأمر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله بعسكر: “The Messenger of God (God bless him and his family) gave orders for his army, and it camped at Thaniyyat al-Wada'. «ولما أراد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله: “When the Messenger of God (God bless him and his family) was about to go out, he left the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) as his deputy over his family, his children, his wives and the abode of his emigration, and said to him:”
«يا علي إن المدينة لا تصلح إلا بي أو بك»: “O Ali, Medina is set right only by me or by you.”

يقرئك السلام: He sends you greetings of peace
«فلما سار غير بعيد نزل جبرئيل عليه السلا: “When he had gone not far, Gabriel (peace be upon him) came down to the Prophet (God bless him and his family) and said to him:”
«إن الله يقرئك السلام، ويقول لك: لا يؤدي: “God sends you greetings of peace and says to you: None shall deliver it on your behalf but you or a man from you.”
«فاستدعى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله عل: “So the Messenger of God (God bless him and his family) summoned Ali (peace be upon him) and said to him:”
«اركب ناقتي العضباء والحق أبا بكر فخذ بر: “Ride my she-camel al-'Adba' and overtake Abu Bakr. Take Bara'a from his hand, go on with it to Mecca, and cast back to the polytheists their covenant. And let Abu Bakr choose between travelling with your riders and returning to me.”
«فركب أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام ناقة رسو: “The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) rode al-'Adba', the she-camel of the Messenger of God (God bless him and his family), and went on until he overtook Abu Bakr.”
«فلحقه بالروحاء فأخذ منه الآيات»: “He overtook him at al-Rawha' and took the verses from him.”
«… واستقبله وقال: فيم جئت يا أبا الحسن؟: “… He came to meet him and said: Why have you come, Abu al-Hasan? Are you travelling with me, or for something else? The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said to him:”

«فقال: بل أرجع إليه، وعاد إلى النبي صلى: “He said: Rather, I will return to him. And he went back to the Prophet (God bless him and his family).”
«فلما دخل عليه قال: يا رسول الله، إنك أه: “When he came in to him he said: O Messenger of God, you found me worthy of a task for which necks stretched toward me, and when I set out for it you turned me back from it. What is with me? Has Qur'an come down about me? The Prophet (God bless him and his family) said:”
«لا، ولكن الأمين هبط إلي عن الله جل جلال: “No. But the Trusted One came down to me from God, majestic is His majesty, that none shall deliver on your behalf but you or a man from you. And Ali is from me, and none shall deliver on my behalf but Ali.”
